name: Onboarding-tour checklist slot
purpose: Owns the checklist surface: the anchor-slot resolution (dashboard-top vs settings-page vs custom-anchor), the collapse contract (<details open> on dashboard-top; <details> closed on settings-page), and the enumeration of the applied tour surfaces with a link back to the restart-tour affordance on the settings surface.
responsibilities: Read the elicited checklist-anchor (ADR-2703) at load and mount the checklist at the resolved slot (AC-26103-1).
Render the checklist as a <details> element carrying data-role="onboarding-tour-checklist" whose open state mirrors the anchor: open on dashboard-top, closed on settings-page (AC-26103-1).
Enumerate the applied tour surfaces as list items with a link to the restart-tour control on the settings surface.
Suppress the checklist entirely when neither the dashboard nor the settings surface is applied and no custom-anchor is supplied.
internalStructure: One checklist module that reads the applied capability set from the sidecar-adjacent applied-blueprint list, picks the anchor per the elicited value or the default derived at apply time, and mounts the <details> element into the resolved slot. The framework is not prescribed.

interfaces.name: renderChecklist
interfaces.description: renderChecklist({ anchor, appliedSet, items }) -> { mount(rootElement), unmount() }. The project supplies the anchor (one of dashboard-top, settings-page, custom-anchor with a selector), the appliedSet (from the applied-blueprint list) and the items (from the manifest walk).

dependencies.name: Step runner
dependencies.description: The checklist links back to the step runner via the restart-tour control on the settings surface.

tradeoffs: The <details>/<summary> collapse contract is chosen over an ARIA APG disclosure widget because <details> ships browser-native keyboard behaviour (Space, Enter to toggle) and screen-reader-native semantics; a bespoke disclosure widget would need every keyboard case re-implemented. The trade-off is styling constraints; the fixture ships an unstyled <details> to make the shape testable.
notes: Composes on application-dashboard for the dashboard-top slot and application-account-settings for the settings-page slot; a project applying neither falls back to a custom-anchor. Known mechanism-reach gap: the checklist cannot inspect which items a principal has already completed without a persistence-blueprint reader; documented under AC-26103-1 as a fixture-side signal only.
